title: Constructing Angles and Regular Polygons
introduction: Explore constructing angles and regular polygons using everyday examples.
definition: A protractor measures angles up to 180 degrees. Place the centre at the vertex and align zero with the starting ray, mark the required angle and draw the second ray. Draw regular polygons on appropriate grids and measure their interior angles.

examples.question: Construct a 60° angle.
steps: Draw a ray, align the protractor, mark 60° and join the vertex to the mark.
